decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit, it fits closely with the firm's established plural-component and injection know-how, so management is likely to keep it and refine it rather than exit quickly.

This product also builds directly on the firm's core application and fluid-handling capabilities, and a medium-sized German machinery producer would usually allow more time to learn from early market feedback before dropping it.
An automatic airless spray gun is strongly related to the firm's long-standing spray equipment competence, giving it high absorptive capacity to improve and support the product commercially.
A manual airless spray gun sits at the center of the firm's existing product and service knowledge, making continued commercialization and incremental improvement the more likely choice.

Because this air-assisted airless spray gun is a multi-model line in one of the firm's core technology areas, management is likely to view it as worth sustaining and optimizing across customer segments.
